question: In which year will India organise the ICC Men’s One-Day International World Cup Cricket?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2031**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India will organise the ICC Men's One-Day International World Cup Cricket in the year **2031**.
 
• This event will be a significant occasion for cricket fans in India and around the world, bringing together the top cricketing nations to compete for the prestigious title.
 
• The tournament is expected to boost the sport's popularity and infrastructure within the country.
 
• India has previously hosted the ICC Men's One-Day International World Cup in 1987, 1996, 2011, and 2023.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The ICC Men's One-Day International World Cup is one of the most watched sporting events globally, drawing millions of viewers.
 
• Hosting the World Cup can have significant economic benefits for the host nation, including tourism and business opportunities.
 
• India's previous hosting of the World Cup in 2011 ended with the Indian team winning the tournament, creating a historic moment in Indian cricket.
 
• The year 2031 will mark the 50th anniversary of India's first World Cup win in 1983, adding an extra layer of significance to the event.
